title: Tech Fest 2026
description: Annual technology festival featuring project demos, tech talks, and innovation challenges from students across all departments.

title: Hackathon 24Hr
description: A 24-hour coding marathon where teams build innovative solutions to real-world problems and compete for exciting prizes.

title: Cultural Night
description: An evening of dance, drama, and music performances celebrating the diverse cultural heritage of our student community.

title: Annual Sports Day
description: A full day of athletic competitions including track events, team sports, and individual contests across all departments.

title: AI & Machine Learning Workshop
description: Hands-on workshop covering neural networks, deep learning frameworks, and practical AI applications with industry experts.

title: Guest Lecture on Entrepreneurship
description: An inspiring talk by a successful startup founder sharing insights on building a business while still in college.

title: Inter-College Debate Competition
description: Students from various colleges compete in a formal debate on current affairs and social issues to sharpen public speaking skills.

title: Science Exhibition
description: An exhibition showcasing innovative science projects and working models built by students from engineering and science departments.

title: Music Concert - Sargam
description: A lively concert featuring performances by the college band, solo artists, and a special guest performance by a popular indie artist.

title: Art Exhibition - Canvas
description: A week-long display of student artwork including paintings, sculptures, digital art, and photography from talented campus artists.

title: National Coding Contest
description: A competitive programming contest with challenging algorithmic problems, open to all students with prizes for top performers.

title: Robotics Workshop
description: A hands-on workshop where students learn to build and program basic robots using Arduino and sensor modules.

title: Career Fair 2026
description: Top companies and recruiters visit campus to offer internships and full-time positions to final year and pre-final year students.

title: Blood Donation Drive
description: A social initiative in collaboration with the Red Cross where students and staff can voluntarily donate blood to save lives.

title: International Yoga Day Celebration
description: A morning yoga session led by a certified instructor promoting fitness, mental well-being, and stress relief among students.
